I research methods to make robots solve tasks robustly, exhibit intrinsic motivation, and agency. Currently I am focusing on Causal World Models, Intrinsic Motivation, and Reinforcement Learning for Robotics at the University of Tübingen and the Max-Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems. Before this I have worked as machine learning engineer and software engineer. 

Here's my updated [resume](files/resume.pdf). You can also find my sporadically updated blog posts [here](blog.qmd).

Send me an email if you wish to collaborate with me or discuss anything interesting!


## Selected Publications
```{python}
import yaml
from IPython.display import display, HTML


def readable_list(_s):
    if len(_s) < 3:
        return " and ".join(map(str, _s))
    *a, b = _s
    return f"{', '.join(map(str, a))}, and {b}"


def button(title, url):
    return f"""<a class="btn btn-outline-dark btn-sm", href="{url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        {title}
    </a>"""


with open("papers.yaml") as paper_f:
    yaml_data = yaml.safe_load(paper_f)
pub_strs = []
for idx, data in yaml_data.items():
    pub_str = ""

    title_str = data.pop("title")
    pub_str += f"\n<div class='title'>{title_str}</div>"

    authors = data.pop("authors")
    authors = [
        a.replace("Sai Prasanna", "<strong>Sai Prasanna</strong>") for a in authors
    ]
    author_str = readable_list(authors)
    pub_str += f"\n<div class='authors'>{author_str}</div>"

    venue = data.pop("venue")
    pub_str += f"\n<div class='venue'>{venue}</div>"
    buttons = []
    for btn in ["pdf", "code", "arxiv", "link", "poster", "talk"]:
        link = data.pop(btn, None)
        if link is not None:
            buttons.append(button(btn.upper(), link))
    pub_strs.append(
        f"<li class='list-group-item' id='{idx}'>{pub_str}<br>{' '.join(buttons)}</li>"
    )

# | output: asis
display(
    HTML(
        "<ul class='publication list-group list-group-flush'>"
        + "\n".join(pub_strs)
        + "</ul>"
    )
)
```
